_doc: Single source of truth for every content photo. o = original file key in assets/img-src, n = new SEO file name (public/static/img/{n}-{sm|md|lg}.webp), alt = what the photo ACTUALLY shows (Arabic, checked by eye), cap = short caption. dup = same photo as another key (merged). blur = rectangles [x1,y1,x2,y2] in the largest source variant to soften third-party logos. Run: python3 qa/tools/build_images.py
